Dossier.description: A published finding version, exactly as emitted by the public projection. Contains no raw transcript body, no evidence body, no provider receipt, and no person-level score or ranking.

corrections.description: Append-only corrections with an explicit review approval.

evidence.description: Approved evidence metadata only: identifiers, URL, dates, and review identifiers. No evidence body or excerpt.

assessment.description: Claim-level assessment. Never a person score.

relations.description: Reviewed longitudinal relations. A relation is never an accusation of intent.

rights_of_reply.description: Only replies that passed their own publication review. A pending or private reply is never projected.

public_role.description: Legacy timeless role. Prefer public_roles, which are dated and review-backed.

FindingSummary.description: Bounded public summary of one published finding version. Contains no score, no ranking, and no transcript or evidence body.

info.description:
Dichiarazioni Pubbliche is an open public-record system for verifiable public statements. This API serves only what the publication gate already approved, with provenance identifiers, assessment, and correction/right-of-reply history.

It is a pure reader over a pre-built projection bundle: no database, no provider, and no LLM is used in the request path, and the product remains fully readable while every model provider is offline. The API is read-only (GET/HEAD only), unauthenticated, and designed to be deployed next to a static host.

Semantics that a consumer must not flatten: retrieved evidence is not approved evidence; approved evidence is not a verified claim; a verified claim is not a published finding; a false claim is not a deliberate falsehood; a position change is not a lie; a contradiction is not proof of intent. There is no person score, no ranking, and no political recommendation, and the API will never return one.

x-deprecation-policy.contract_gate: This document describes the v1 HTTP contract over the dichiarazioni-pubbliche-public-v2 public projection. The URL major version and the projection schema version are independent axes; a future projection schema that is not backward compatible requires a new URL major version.
x-deprecation-policy.current_contract_status: DRAFT: served and cacheable, but not yet announced as stable. The same-origin MiniPC read path has been runtime-proved; the remaining gate is contract/release ratification, not transport reachability.
x-deprecation-policy.enum_values: New assessment, publication-status, relation, and claim-type values are owned by the public schema contract, not by this document, and are never added silently where an existing consumer could read them as a safety or policy decision.
x-deprecation-policy.sunset: A deprecation announces the replacement endpoint, a first deprecation date, and a sunset date no earlier than 90 days later. Deprecated endpoints emit the Deprecation and Sunset headers and stay readable until sunset. No endpoint is ever removed silently.
x-deprecation-policy.version_boundary: The URL major version (/api/v1) is the compatibility boundary. A breaking change is served under a new major version.

publication_guarantees: A finding is served only because it is already in the fail-closed public projection.
The API never re-implements, relaxes, or bypasses the publication gate.
A non-PUBLISH dossier is not in the bundle and therefore is not served.
The API returns 503 rather than partial data when the projection is missing, stale, or incompatible.
Raw transcript bodies, evidence bodies, provider receipts, secrets, and private replies are never returned.

429.note: Reserved for a future release. Clients should handle 429 defensively even though this implementation never emits it.

rate_limiting.expectation: Requests are served from cache and are expected to be infrequent. No rate-limit enforcement or authentication is present in this deployment; clients must not treat the absence of a 429 as unlimited throughput.
